}

statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dim-1-nonproper-affine}
Let $X$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$.
If $\dim(X) \leq 1$ and no irreducible component of $X$
is proper of dimension $1$, then $X$ is affine.
